media.note: owner-supplied iso; microsoft withdrawal of downloads makes owner media the only reliable path

activation.note: owner-supplied product key or volume media; activation is not repeatable, so activated installs are kept as snapshots

constraints: no virtio drivers in box: use sata/ide emulation or slipstream the drivers into the install media
unpatched 7 cannot speak tls 1.2: any https the bridge needs must terminate on the guest's host
modern qemu cpu models fail to boot this kernel: qemu64 or haswell-no-tsx must be pinned in the manifest
activation servers for 7 are degraded: activate once, snapshot immediately, never re-activate
guest additions/agent builds are ancient and most download links are dead
end of support 2020-01: never credentialed, never a pool identity
